description: What a hosted app or bot may reach on the internet: the policy (open, meaning everything out, or allowlist, meaning only the rules below), the rules themselves as protocol, ports and optional destination range, the ports that are closed for every app whatever a list says, whether mail through a provider is open to it, and how many rules it may hold. Says whether the node blocks what is off the list or only counts it, which is not the same thing and must not be reported as blocking. A free app is on the fixed free list and cannot change it; a paid app has its own, which set_app_firewall writes. Needs the app id (bot_...) from list_bots and full access to it, the same as the panel Firewall tab. Use get_app_refusals for what the node actually turned away.
name: get_app_firewall

always_blocked.description: Closed for every app on every tier, and so never allowed by a rule either.

applies_on_next_start.description: True when the running container was created before the current settings, so they take hold on its next start.

editable.description: Whether set_app_firewall can change this list.

enforced.description: True when the node blocks what is off the list. False means it only counts it, so nothing is actually being blocked.

mail_allowed.description: Whether this app may reach a mail provider on 465 and 587. Port 25 is closed for every app.

max_rules.description: The most rules a list may hold.

on_private_network.description: Whether the app sits on the owner private network. What that needs is added to the list and is not shown as a rule of the owner.

plan.description: free or paid. Only a paid app has a list of its own.

policy.description: open means everything out is allowed. allowlist means only the rules are.

rules.description: The list this app is on.

destination.description: An IPv4 range the rule is narrowed to, or null for anywhere.

label.description: The usual service on that port, when there is a name for it.

ports.description: One port, like 443, or a range, like 50000-65535.

title: Get app firewall
